ecosystem_regime.interpretation: Robinhood remains the dominant speculative venue by raw turnover, but normalized DEX volume is falling while raw DEX volume is rising sharply. The divergence, negative net inflows, previously observed wash-volume filtering, and newly active exchange trading incentives mean raw volume/trader counts should be materially discounted as evidence of discretionary capital migration.

gate_alpha_hot_token_competition.framework_treatment: DISCOUNT Gate Alpha volume/user growth during the event because activity is directly rewarded. This is the exact incentive contamination the framework is designed to reject rather than count as discretionary speculation.

new_hard_gate_rejection.reason: Bubblemaps-linked reporting indicates more than 75 fresh wallets with similar funding and no prior activity acquired roughly 80% of CHUMP supply in closely timed purchases; related wallets were reportedly funded through Relay and later attempted to obscure funding provenance through another wallet group selling via Uniswap. This directly fails linked-wallet, correlated-funding, supply-concentration, suspicious-transfer and manipulation gates.

cross_ecosystem_result: No second ecosystem clears the same regime threshold. Solana, Base, BSC and Monad remain negative on weekly spot DEX growth in the current comparison set; Sonic is too small and contracting; Canton remains incentive-distorted; X Layer's raw DEX acceleration is contradicted by declining stablecoins/TVL and weak fee/inflow evidence.
why_signal_matters_now: The experiment has a fresh falsifiable quality-control event: Robinhood's headline activity is being amplified by explicit exchange incentives at the same time normalized DEX volume is declining. CHUMP simultaneously demonstrates why correlated funding and wallet-linkage gates are necessary even for a top-performing token. PONS remains leader, but there is no new qualified asset alert from this run.
uncertainties: Normalized-volume methodology captures a narrower quality-adjusted subset and should not be interpreted as a perfect measure of organic speculation.
No fresh full funding graph was completed for PONS, AI or CASHCAT this run.
Exchange listings and promotions can create genuine new discretionary demand as well as incentivized churn; only the explicitly rewarded component is rejected outright.
CHUMP controller identity remains unknown; the rejection is based on wallet-linkage/funding-pattern evidence rather than attribution to a named actor.
